scope: Relation-family crosswalk, not a completed per-sutra or raw-text accuracy audit

source.title: Guidelines for the Semantic Analysis of Sanskrit Sentences following Paninian Karaka theory
source.author: Amba Kulkarni

families.representation: KarakaRelation separates resolved role, written case, canonical evidence, alternatives and coexisting designations.
remaining: Reassess each canonical rule on the three audit axes.
Review unannotated PVM clauses against intended meaning; fixture counts do not establish raw-text inference.

families.representation: PROMPTER_CAUSE and CAUSEE_AGENT premises coexist with canonical roles; HETU is a separate designation.
remaining: Audit nested causatives and all causee-promotion choices.
Decide whether downstream consumers require a first-class semantic-function projection instead of inspecting premise provenance.

families.representation: Prayoga and governing-krt expressed-role readings drive case licensing; finite agreement is checked separately.
remaining: Audit explicit exported controller identity for finite, nominal and omitted-participant constructions.
Complete dvikarmaka and causative passive promotion coverage.

families.representation: PriorActionStructure, Purvakalika and SharedParticipant preserve actual action owners and written participants.
remaining: Add separately typed and justified simultaneity and absolute-construction relations; current KriyaLink has no such variants.
Resolve remaining passive prior-chain attachment and execution obligations without copying patient case forms into agent positions.

families.representation: NominalAttachment retains attributive/predicative candidates, agreement possibilities, meaning dimensions and independent readings.
remaining: Establish attachment and predicative scope using construction evidence; agreement alone is insufficient.
Audit object predication separately from ordinary noun modification and avoid positional shortcuts.

families.representation: KriyaQualification distinguishes indeclinables from case forms. AdverbialScopeResolver validates event, proposition or constituent targets.
remaining: Expand justified lexical/case-form coverage and infer scope when sentence evidence suffices.
Retain nominal alternatives and unresolved targets; identical words must not substitute for distinct occurrences.

families.representation: AdverbialFunction distinguishes NEGATION and PROHIBITION; proposition scope is distinct from event scope.
remaining: Audit proposition, constituent and imperative scope through actual PVM analysis and execution.

families.representation: NominalCaseLinkAnalysis separates conditional governor candidates, missing premises, established links and joint case alternatives.
remaining: Map each supported non-karaka relation to its canonical case evidence without manufacturing a 1.4 designation.
Audit general possessive/genitive head attachment separately from merely licensing a genitive case.
Audit all applicable upapada domains and competing governors; case compatibility alone cannot establish a link.

families.representation: PurposeActionGovernor and PurposeKarakaRelation preserve written or supplied action ownership; reason and purpose premises remain distinct.
remaining: Audit reason versus purpose ambiguity and omitted-action inference.
Do not turn a supplied implied action into an invented written occurrence or execution operation.

families.representation: KriyaLink has Condition, Alternative and Coordination, plus shared participants; parser and runtime retain structured program control flow.
remaining: Map supported connectors individually instead of equating condition, temporal correlation, cause-effect and concession.
Audit graph versus runtime control-flow semantics; the current KriyaLink inventory has no dedicated cause-effect or concession edge.
Separate clausal-content quotation from command/text quotation before claiming general quotation semantics.

nextActions: Build the per-canonical-rule ledger with concrete correctness/integration criteria; this family map is not its replacement.
Validate selected source examples independently before converting them to JSON expectations.
Use the PVM source audit to prioritize unreviewed real clauses alongside relation-model gaps.
